name: combat3d
description: 3D anime action engine for #html Volt games (Three.js loaded from a CDN): cel-shaded rigs, bloom and screen distortion, per-character cursed-energy auras, slashes, Black Flash, domain expansions, a destructible city map, procedural audio and an anime HUD. Gameplay stays in Volt.

snippets.label: Combat 3D engine (Three.js, auras, domains, map, HUD, audio)
snippets.description: Paste at the top of an #html program; see examples/26_cursed_arena_3d.volt for the gameplay layer that drives it.
